# Kristofer Öhman

> Live with joy, explore without limits, act with presence and never stop evolving. Technologist and explorer, curious about the brain and what makes people thrive. CTO at Apohem, a Swedish online pharmacy.

## About

- Health: whole, optimized; sleep, movement, food, mind and people as one system
- Lens: psychological capital (hope, efficacy, resilience, optimism), on teams and on oneself
- Work: CTO at Apohem, taking it from AI First to AI Native; ex adidas, Klarna, CIO roles, co-founder through to exit
- Open to: board and advisory roles
